verdict.rationale: Abacum's own claims cover two of the three formats. The investor-reporting page says the deck builds itself with no copy-paste between the model and the slides. The Excel connector lets users push and pull data between Excel and Abacum, which is roughly spreadsheet output. Neither is documented as an explicit report-export feature, and PDF is never mentioned. Missing for 10: PDF export, explicit documentation of exporting reports to slide or spreadsheet files, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export reports to slides, PDF, or spreadsheet formats

citations.quote: Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself. No copy-paste between the model, the slides and the memo.
Push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum, eliminating copy-paste errors
